# Package index

## All functions

- [`d_optimize_core()`](https://biodoe.readthedocs.io/en/latest/r_api/reference/d_optimize_core.md)
  : Augment an existing design using D-optimality
- [`dunnett_power_analytic()`](https://biodoe.readthedocs.io/en/latest/r_api/reference/dunnett_power_analytic.md)
  : Calculate analytical power for Dunnett's multiple-comparison test
- [`generate_clusters()`](https://biodoe.readthedocs.io/en/latest/r_api/reference/generate_clusters.md)
  : Generate simulated single-cell RNA-seq count data
